title: Control Attestation Campaign Roll-Up
description: Roll-up of a caller-declared control-attestation campaign: completion percentage, exception rate, below-threshold flag against a declared escalation threshold, and an ESCALATION_FLAGGED / NO_ESCALATION verdict. Declared counts only: attested, exception, and unresponded are your declarations, never observations this page makes; it reads no register, GRC system, or control repository. Absent or invalid inputs fail closed and are named. Rounding is 2dp half-up. No network, no storage, no clock.

controls_total.description: Declared total controls in the campaign, integer in [1, 100000].

attested.description: Declared count of attested controls, integer in [0, controls_total].

exceptions.description: Declared count of controls with exceptions, integer in [0, controls_total].

unresponded.description: Declared count of control owners who have not responded, integer in [0, controls_total].

escalation_threshold_pct.description: Declared completion escalation threshold, number in [0, 100].
